name: Volt Industrial Plastics Inc
old_description: Founded by Joe Voltrauer, Volt Industrial Plastics has a history of rising above and providing quality parts with passion. From Germany to Arkansas, the Volltrauer story is an impressive one, and one that molds the very parts being produced to this day. Watch the video below to learn more about Volt's history.
about:
Volt Industrial Plastics Inc operates from Yellville, Arkansas. Founded by Joe Voltrauer, the company traces its roots from Germany to Arkansas and has been providing custom plastic fastener solutions for over three decades. The Voltrauer family story continues to mold the parts produced today.

The company manufactures a wide range of plastic fasteners under one roof, including bushings, washers, threaded rod, stem bumpers, standoffs, rivets, push-in fasteners, pins, spacers, screws, studs, nuts, metric hardware, clips, circuit board hardware, caps, plugs, and cable routing components. The product line also features cable clamps, wire clamps, dowel pins, hex nuts, plastic rivets, security screws, plastic washers, cup washers, hole plugs, and square head screws. All items are crafted in the Yellville facility, allowing the company to control quality and lead times.

Volt serves national and global markets, with its circuit board hardware category indicating a presence in the electronics sector. The company emphasizes American-made production and worldwide shipping without hidden fees, targeting customers who value domestic sourcing and transparent pricing.

The Volt difference is built on passion-driven engineering, customer care, and domestic manufacturing. Founder Joe Voltrauer’s story of rising above challenges shapes the company’s focus on quality parts and knowledgeable customer service, with representatives available directly by phone.
